This captures the concept of high frequency raising dehydration risk and need for care, albeit with slightly different threshold wording.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Gold hpi-001 covers diarrhoea for 3 days; frequency 4–5/day is in gold hpi-006, but generated hpi-001 combines duration and frequency into one fact and omits the watery/consistency context.
